entries.name: Anticipation
entries.one_line: Two dots cross the same track: the grey one just goes, the yellow one first pulls back and squashes for a beat, then launches, so the viewer knows where it is headed.

entries.name: Arcs
entries.one_line: A grey dot slides straight along the top track while a yellow ball covers the same distance in the same time on a parabola below, leaving a trail of dots behind it and settling with a small hop.

entries.name: Easing
entries.one_line: Three dots cover the same distance in the same time with a linear, ease-in and ease-out curve, so only their speed differs; small graphs of each curve appear once they arrive together.

entries.name: Follow-through
entries.one_line: A post slides right and stops dead; the yellow flag on top trails behind during the move, swings past the stop through inertia, and rocks back and forth in smaller swings until it settles.

entries.name: Motion hierarchy
entries.one_line: A big title rises in first and slowest, the subtitle follows with a shorter lift, then the detail line and a divider snap in last, so the size and the timing both say what to read first; numbered leaders mark the order.

entries.name: Overlapping action
entries.one_line: Two jointed shapes slide right: the top one as a rigid block, the bottom one with each part leaving and stopping a little later than the one ahead, so it reads as one flexible body.

entries.name: Spring & overshoot
entries.one_line: A card grows from nothing, briefly overshoots to 1.08 of its size and settles back to 1.00, while a graph beside it draws the same curve and a readout tracks the scale; a selection ring then springs on.

entries.name: Squash & stretch
entries.one_line: A yellow ball drops 340 px, stretching tall as it speeds up, squashes flat on the floor at impact, and bounces back twice more with smaller squashes, its width and height always trading off so the volume reads constant.

entries.name: Stagger
entries.one_line: Twelve blocks in a 4 by 3 grid rise and fade in one after another in reading order, 0.06 s apart, the last one yellow; a small ripple then runs through the grid in the same order.

entries.name: Blinds reveal
entries.one_line: Six vertical strips wipe open one after another from left to right, each uncovering its slice of the same headline and big number until the whole picture is assembled; then they close again in order.

entries.name: Blur reveal
entries.one_line: A headline, then a big number, emerge from a soft 12 px blur and fade up into sharp focus without moving, as if coming out of mist; a caption resolves last.

entries.name: Fade slide
entries.one_line: A headline, a big number and a caption each fade in while sliding up 24 px into place, one after another, and a Continue button arrives the same way a beat later.

entries.name: Flip reveal
entries.one_line: A card starts edge-on and turns around its vertical axis to face the viewer, fading in as it comes; it then turns away and a second card flips in to take its place.

entries.name: Scale pop
entries.one_line: A round result badge grows from nothing to full size out of its own centre with an ease-out, a small yellow dot pops on after it, and both shrink back to nothing at the end.

entries.name: Circumscribe
entries.one_line: A yellow rectangle draws itself around the big number, holds, fades away, then draws around the line of text beside it: one item picked out at a time, then released.

entries.name: Focus handoff
entries.one_line: Four steps sit in a row; one at a time lights up with a yellow dot and full ink while the others stay faint, and the highlight hands off to the next step.

entries.name: Pulse
entries.one_line: A yellow Continue button beats three times, growing to 1.05 and settling back in place while a soft ring spreads from it; nothing else moves.

entries.name: Shake
entries.one_line: An invite-code field with a yellow exclamation mark shakes left and right with shrinking swings and lands back on its rest position; the error line fades in under it, then a second smaller shake follows.

entries.name: Keyword glow
entries.one_line: The words of a dim line light up one at a time as if spoken, each swelling and glowing yellow before settling back, with the last word held longest.

entries.name: Context-sensitive cursor
entries.one_line: A block cursor types the line and changes colour with what it is typing: dark on plain words, yellow and taller on the keyword, grey on a trailing hint, dark again on the check mark.

entries.name: Counting with dynamic scale
entries.one_line: A big number counts up from zero to 1,284 while growing to full size, then a plus sign pops in beside it and a yellow label sits beneath.

entries.name: Discrete text sequence
entries.one_line: A prompt types the line in bursts, pauses at a word, makes a typo, backspaces, then pastes the rest in one jump and ends with a check mark while a yellow block cursor blinks.

entries.name: Dynamic content sequencing
entries.one_line: A card hard-cuts through three steps, each shown for a time set by how much text it carries, while a yellow progress bar fills steadily underneath.

entries.name: Gradient text sweep
entries.one_line: A band of yellow light slides left to right through the letters of a held dark headline (the continuous sweep form); the letters themselves never move.

entries.name: Kinetic beat slam
entries.one_line: Three short lines hit on a steady beat with different entrances (a blurred slam, a side snap, a rising tilt) while a small yellow metronome ticks below, then the stack holds.

entries.name: Vertical spring ticker
entries.one_line: A word in a yellow window rolls up slot-machine style, click, click, pause, then one big spring-and-land on the final word.

entries.name: Per-character rise
entries.one_line: The characters of 'Every frame is code.' rise 64 px from below and fade in one after another in reading order; a second smaller line follows the same way.

entries.name: Kinetic type sweep
entries.one_line: Three lines of 200 px type stream across the frame in opposite directions at different speeds; the middle line slams to a stop with 'Launch day' dead centre in yellow while the other two fade to ghosts.

entries.name: Mask reveal
entries.one_line: Three lines of a title rise into clipped windows one after another, each appearing from below its own invisible edge, hold, then slide up and out the same way.

entries.name: Text scramble
entries.one_line: Every character slot of 'Every frame is code.' cycles through symbols, and from the left the slots lock into the real letters one by one, the next slot to lock shown in yellow.

entries.name: Underline draw
entries.one_line: A slightly curved yellow stroke draws itself from left to right beneath 'is code' in one continuous hand-drawn motion, then a second shorter stroke follows under it.

entries.name: Word emphasis
entries.one_line: Inside a sentence that does not move, 'is code' turns yellow and grows to 1.06 while the surrounding words fade to a third of their ink; later the emphasis releases and the sentence evens out again.

entries.name: Font shuffle
entries.one_line: A sentence stays still while one word swaps typeface on every beat, serif then mono then heavy sans, with a beat dot pulsing under it, and lands back on the original face.

entries.name: Glyph roll
entries.one_line: A status pill whose letters each sit in a clipped slot: the slots roll upward one after another so Draft becomes Review, then roll again to Live as the pill's dot turns yellow.

entries.name: Handwriting write-on
entries.one_line: A cursive headline writes itself stroke by stroke with a yellow pen tip leading each line, then the full stop is erased and written again.

entries.name: Inline image expand
entries.one_line: A small yellow picture sitting between the words of a headline grows into a card as the words slide apart to make room, holds, then shrinks back and the line closes.

entries.name: Letter anagram shift
entries.one_line: The five letters of a big word travel down and shrink into place as the initials of five list items, the rest of each word fades in after its letter, and a yellow bar underlines one item.

entries.name: Letter drop pile
entries.one_line: The letters of a headline detach one after another, fall with a bounce and come to rest tilted in a heap on the floor line, which then settles.

entries.name: Phrase push build
entries.one_line: "Every frame is code." builds one word at a time: each new word slides in from the right and pushes the earlier words left so the growing phrase stays centred, then a yellow rule draws under it.

entries.name: Quote card build
entries.one_line: A quote card builds in reading order: the big yellow quotation mark pops, two lines rise in turn, a hairline draws, then the speaker's name slides in and their avatar pops last.

entries.name: Repeated text wall
entries.one_line: One short phrase repeats into nine rows that drop in from the top and fill the frame with alternating offsets, the outer rows fading lighter; the rows then drift sideways and the middle one turns yellow.

entries.name: Scene-integrated title
entries.one_line: A thin vertical line with a yellow head sweeps across the frame and a huge title appears only where the line has passed; on the way back the line wipes the title away again.

entries.name: Spatial word composition
entries.one_line: Four words of one line appear in spoken order at different sizes and tilts, scattered across the frame as one type poster with the last word big and yellow; the poster then pushes in slowly.

entries.name: Split flap
entries.one_line: A two-row departure-style board of dark flap cards: each card's top half folds down and a new bottom half swings up through a couple of stray glyphs, left to right, until the rows spell out the headline and a seat count.

entries.name: Strikethrough replace
entries.one_line: A line draws left to right through the old value, the old text dims, and the new value rises into place below it; a second pair then does the same for a second figure.

entries.name: Text wave
entries.one_line: A narrow wave runs left to right along a headline twice, lifting and slightly enlarging only the three or four glyphs it is passing while the rest of the line stays on its baseline.

entries.name: Text window fill
entries.one_line: Huge outlined letters act as windows: diagonal yellow and ink bands drift across and slowly swell inside the letter shapes only, while the outlines never move.

entries.name: Tracking reveal
entries.one_line: The letters of a big title start widely spaced and fade in as they tighten into one compact word; a rule draws beneath and a subtitle tightens in the same way.

entries.name: Variable font axis morph
entries.one_line: A line of text thickens from a light voice to a heavy one glyph by glyph as it widens, then relaxes back; the system font's weight axis is real and the width axis is faked with a horizontal stretch.

entries.name: Variable font weight wave
entries.one_line: A crest of heavy, slightly slanted letters travels through a light line of text twice, each glyph swelling to bold and relaxing as the wave passes; a yellow marker tracks the crest below.

entries.name: Word relay
entries.one_line: Three huge words take turns: each slides in from the right, holds at centre and slides out left as the next arrives; the last word, in yellow, stays as the conclusion while a dot row tracks the handoff.

entries.name: Word rise fade
entries.one_line: A headline builds word by word, each word rising a little as it sheds its blur and fades in; a yellow mark and a smaller caption line follow with the same soft reveal.

entries.name: Word slot cycle
entries.one_line: The headline "Invite your ___" stays put while the last word cycles team, clients, partners: each outgoing word rises and blurs away as the next one comes up from below into the same slot.

entries.name: Card morph anchor
entries.one_line: A small yellow pill holds a beat, then grows and squares off into a full card while its label fades out and the card's headline and number fade in.

entries.name: Control target sync
entries.one_line: An inspector value scrubs from 0 to -10 degrees while the button tilts in the same frame, then a size field steps Medium, Large, Small, Large and the button snaps to each size as the text changes.

entries.name: Cursor click ripple
entries.one_line: A cursor darts to the button, presses it (both compress together), and three rings ping outward from the click point.

entries.name: Cursor drag
entries.one_line: A cursor grabs a button chip from a tray, a translucent copy rides under it in lockstep across to the layout, and it snaps into place with corner handles on the drop (grab, carry, drop form).

entries.name: Motion blur streak
entries.one_line: A huge 98% whips in from the left as a horizontal smear and snaps razor-sharp the instant it stops, then a headline streaks in from the right the same way (directional blur form).

entries.name: Multi cursor choreography
entries.one_line: Three named cursors (Jamie, Sam, Morgan) work one canvas at once: one highlights a headline, one carries a chip into a slot, one glides and rests, while the canvas drifts slowly.

entries.name: Nudge curve
entries.one_line: A stack of word rows eases into a quick slide left and creeps to rest, a yellow button appearing in the space it made; then the whole group nudges up the same way to make room for a line below.

entries.name: Physics press reaction
entries.one_line: A cursor glides onto the button, cursor and button shrink together as one press, then both spring back with an overshoot before the cursor drifts away.

entries.name: Press release spring
entries.one_line: A resting button sinks flat with a quick linear press, springs back past its size, and a soft yellow burst and room glow bloom behind it on release.

entries.name: Reactive displacement
entries.one_line: A new card flies in tilted from the right and knocks the old card off to the left, then plants with a small wobble.

entries.name: Scale swap transition
entries.one_line: One card shrinks and fades away while the next pops up in its place with a small overshoot, then its subtitle slides in; shown twice as Draft, Review, Live.

entries.name: Spring pop entrance
entries.one_line: A headline grows from nothing to full size with a smooth settle, three stat cards pop in one quick wave, and the button arrives last.

entries.name: Theme crossfade morph
entries.one_line: The whole card re-skins in quick blends from light and rounded to dark and square to yellow and pill-shaped, while the Continue button stays exactly where it is.

entries.name: Waterfall entry
entries.one_line: The words of a headline whip up from below one after another in an accelerating wave, each appearing instantly and snapping into line, then three stat chips cascade in the same way.

entries.name: Band slide
entries.one_line: The first scene is sliced into eight horizontal bands that slide out to the right one after another, each starting a little later than the one above, so the next scene appears line by line.

entries.name: Blur dissolve
entries.one_line: The card scene and the number scene overlap while blurred, swap, and the new scene sharpens back into focus.

entries.name: Chapter interstitial
entries.one_line: A dark step-title card (number, title, step count) rises in between two scenes, holds long enough to read, then lifts away to reveal the next scene.

entries.name: Crossfade
entries.one_line: Scene A (a card) fades out as scene B (a big number) fades in at the same time, so both scenes briefly coexist.

entries.name: Flash transition
entries.one_line: A white flash covers the frame, the card scene is swapped for the number scene at the peak, and brightness recovers.

entries.name: Glitch transition
entries.one_line: Horizontal slices of the first scene jump sideways and skew in stepped, seeded jolts while a faint ghost copy lags behind; halfway through the jolts the scene underneath is already the next one, and the slices snap away.

entries.name: Grid flip
entries.one_line: The scene is cut into a grid of 8 by 5 tiles that flip over one after another in a wave from the top left, each showing a piece of the next scene on its back.

entries.name: Shape mask transition
entries.one_line: A circular mask expands from a yellow dot at the centre of the card scene to reveal the number scene behind it.

entries.name: Match cut
entries.one_line: A sentence's yellow full stop grows, then a hard cut lands on a chart dot at the same position and size, so the eye stays in place.

entries.name: Morph match cut
entries.one_line: A yellow circle grows into place, hard-cuts to a letter O of the same height and centre, then the O morphs into a 98% donut chart while the camera pushes in and pans.

entries.name: Noise dissolve
entries.one_line: Blotchy holes with a thin yellow rim open in a dark cover scene wherever a baked cloud of noise falls below the progress, spreading until the light scene underneath shows through completely.

entries.name: Page turn
entries.one_line: The right half of the first scene lifts at the centre like a book page and folds over to the left in perspective, with a soft shadow; its back carries the next scene, which is left in place when the page lands.

entries.name: Push
entries.one_line: An incoming scene slides in from the right and pushes the card scene out by the same amount in the same direction.

entries.name: Shader directional warp wipe
entries.one_line: A soft, bent diagonal edge sweeps from the top left to the bottom right; near the edge both scenes smear along the direction of travel as the light card scene is swept away and the dark number scene takes over, its count still climbing.

entries.name: Morph
entries.one_line: The same element turns from an ink square into a yellow circle and then into the first bar of the next scene's chart.

entries.name: Split slide
entries.one_line: The first scene is cut into a left and a right half that slide apart like doors, in opposite directions at the same time, uncovering the next scene already sitting underneath.

entries.name: Whip pan
entries.one_line: A rapid leftward sweep with horizontal blur and a sharp deceleration carries the card scene off and settles into the number scene.

entries.name: Wipe
entries.one_line: A boundary line moves left to right and progressively reveals the number scene over the card scene behind it.

entries.name: Zoom through
entries.one_line: The opening of a big letter O enlarges past the frame and carries the viewer through to the number scene inside it.

entries.name: Zoom wipe
entries.one_line: The first scene zooms in toward the centre while a straight vertical edge sweeps left to right and uncovers the next scene, which zooms out to rest at the same time.

entries.name: Additive dissolve
entries.one_line: An invite card crossfades into a stats card on a dark ground with the incoming card screen-blended, so the overlap glows brighter in the middle before the new card settles to normal.

entries.name: Bounce transition
entries.one_line: A stats card scene drops in from above, bounces three times on the invite scene with a soft shadow under its leading edge, settles covering it, and its avatars pop in.

entries.name: Burn transition
entries.one_line: An irregular burning edge spreads out from the invite card's button, eating the dark scene away with a hot yellow-to-orange rim, and leaves the stats card behind it.

entries.name: Channel phase dissolve
entries.one_line: An invite card dissolves into a stats card one colour channel at a time: the red copy swaps first, then green, then blue, so the edges fringe in colour mid-way before the three line up again.

entries.name: Chromatic wipe
entries.one_line: The invite scene splits into red, green and blue copies that slide away left at different speeds while a wipe uncovers the stats scene, whose colour copies drift back together.

entries.name: Clock wipe
entries.one_line: A pie-shaped edge sweeps clockwise from twelve o'clock around the centre, uncovering the stats scene over the invite scene; after it closes, the hand sweeps back forty degrees and returns.

entries.name: Clone wall wipe
entries.one_line: A wall of 24 tiles each repeating the word Orbit fills the frame row by row over an invite card, snaps from yellow-on-ink to ink-on-yellow, then clears in the same order to reveal a stats card.

entries.name: Colour distance dissolve
entries.one_line: An invite scene dissolves into a stats scene tile by tile in an order set by the picture itself: tiles where the two scenes already match melt across first, and the yellow button, where they differ most, swaps last.

entries.name: Column melt
entries.one_line: The invite scene is cut into twelve vertical strips that drop out of the frame at different seeded delays and speeds, like a melting screen, leaving the stats scene behind.

entries.name: Cross cutting
entries.one_line: Two places alternate in four hard cuts that come faster each time: one panel where a cursor sends an invite and one inbox panel where the invite lands as a new row, each advancing its own action between cuts.

entries.name: Cube transition
entries.one_line: The invite scene and the stats scene sit on neighbouring faces of a cube that steps back and turns ninety degrees in perspective, with a faint reflection following on the floor.

entries.name: Cutaway
entries.one_line: A cursor heads for the Continue button on an invite card, the picture cuts to a close-up of the press for a moment, and cuts back to find the action advanced to the stats card.

entries.name: Datamosh transition
entries.one_line: An invite scene tears into 24 horizontal strips that slide sideways while narrow vertical slits jump out of line, blurred residue of the old picture smears across, and the stats scene takes over underneath.

entries.name: Dip to color
entries.one_line: The invite scene softens and sinks into a flat ink field, the field holds for a beat, and the stats scene rises out of the same colour and sharpens.

entries.name: Edge trace transition
entries.one_line: The surfaces of an invite card fade away until only its ink outlines remain as a line drawing on white paper; the drawing holds, becomes the outline of a stats card, and that card fills back in.

entries.name: Exit before enter
entries.one_line: An invite card lifts and fades out completely, the ground sits empty for a beat, then a stats card rises and fades in to the same spot; no frame shows both, and the swap runs back the other way.

entries.name: Eyeline match
entries.one_line: A shape avatar's two eye dots glance up to the right, and the picture cuts to the invite card on the right side of the frame; the eyes glance left and the card follows to the left.

entries.name: Fly eye transition
entries.one_line: A grid of 24 round lenses swells over an invite scene on a dark ground, each magnifying its patch with a warm and a cool colour fringe, while the stats scene crosses in underneath; the lenses relax flat as it lands.

entries.name: Frame border transition
entries.one_line: A thick ink frame grows inward from every edge until it covers an invite card, then pulls back outward and stops as a wide border enclosing the stats card, which settles into place and the frame breathes once.

entries.name: Freeze cut
entries.one_line: A cursor crosses an invite card toward Continue and freezes mid-move; the still drains some colour, a vignette closes in and it creeps larger for half a second, then a hard cut lands on the stats card.

entries.name: Freeze frame dressing
entries.one_line: A cursor presses Invite on a member row and the picture freezes as it lifts away; a tape strip, a paper name label and a yellow sticker stick onto the frozen frame one after another while it creeps larger.

entries.name: Gravitational lens transition
entries.one_line: The invite card bends toward its centre in concentric rings as light gathers into a bright yellow ring, the stats card takes over at the peak of the warp and relaxes back to flat as the ring releases.

entries.name: Grayscale dissolve
entries.one_line: The invite card loses its colour as it fades, the two scenes mix in black and white with the yellow button and bar gone grey, and colour comes back as the stats card lands; the same dissolve then carries it back.

entries.name: Halftone dissolve
entries.one_line: Round holes on a 48 px grid open in the invite scene, growing in a wave from the top-left corner until they merge, and the stats scene shows through the holes.

entries.name: Hard cut
entries.one_line: The invite card with its drifting cursor switches straight to the stats card at one second with no overlap, the number ticks up and the bar fills, then it cuts straight back and the cursor presses Continue.

entries.name: Held scene overlap
entries.one_line: The stats card starts rising from the bottom while the cursor on the invite card is still moving; the cursor is held frozen for a beat as the new card's bar keeps filling, then the reveal completes in one frame.

entries.name: HSV dissolve
entries.one_line: As the invite card fades its yellow button travels round the colour wheel through green to blue, the stats card arrives from the far side of the wheel with its own accents tinted, and both land on clean yellow; the same dissolve then carries it back.

entries.name: Insert shot
entries.one_line: A wide view of the invite card, a straight cut into a three-times close-up of the Continue button as the cursor presses it and it turns dark, then a straight cut back to the wide card with the button now dark and the line beneath the title updated.

entries.name: Jump cut
entries.one_line: Inside the same framing a member list jumps from one row to two to three with no motion between, the cursor landing somewhere new on each cut, then the seats-left tag flips from three to zero and the frame jumps once more.

entries.name: Kaleidoscope transition
entries.one_line: The invite card folds into six mirrored wedge fragments that turn a quarter circle around the centre, the fragments switch to the stats card at the peak, and the picture unfolds back to a plain frame.

entries.name: Lens flare transition
entries.one_line: A bright point with a long streak and three optical rings sweeps across the frame on the diagonal, the cut from the invite card to the stats card hides under a warm wash as it passes the centre, and it fades out past the corner; a small glint later catches the end of the bar.

entries.name: Light leak transition
entries.one_line: A wide irregular patch of warm yellow light blooms in from the left over the invite card, the cut to the stats card hides under it while it holds, and it burns out to the right; a faint second leak breathes at the edge later.

entries.name: Light ray transition
entries.one_line: Twenty-four rays of yellow-white light shoot out from the centre of the invite card until they cover the frame, the stats card is underneath when they clear, and a quieter burst flickers from the same point later.

entries.name: Luma wipe
entries.one_line: A 16 by 9 grid of tiles swaps the invite card for the stats scene in brightness order: the light ground and card surface go first, the dark headline and the yellow button hold out last, then the new rows settle in.

entries.name: Luminance melt
entries.one_line: The invite card melts downward in vertical strips that stretch as they slide off the stage, the light ground strips first and the dark headline and yellow button last, uncovering the stats scene underneath.

entries.name: Match on action
entries.one_line: The cursor speeds right across the invite card and leaves the stage, the cut lands while it is off screen, and in the stats card a yellow dot enters from the left on the same line at the same speed and slows to a stop after the number.

entries.name: Mirror transition
entries.one_line: The invite scene mirrors itself across the centre line, both halves fold to the middle like a closing book, and the stats scene unfolds from the same crease, its rows settling in after.

entries.name: Montage
entries.one_line: Four product shots cut hard one after another, Record with rising waveform bars, Edit with a playhead crossing a track, Ship with the cursor pressing the button, then the result number holds and settles, a dot strip marking the step.

entries.name: Mosaic traversal
entries.one_line: The invite card zooms out into a 5 by 3 mosaic of cloned tiles, the camera slides two tiles right and one up, and zooms back in on the one tile that holds the stats scene, whose rows then settle in.

entries.name: Multiply dissolve
entries.one_line: The stats scene fades over the invite card in multiply blend so the overlap sinks darker where either scene is dark, then the invite card fades away and the stats scene's brightness comes back, its rows settling in.

entries.name: Origami fold
entries.one_line: On a dark stage the invite scene folds into four vertical panels that turn edge-on one after another in a zigzag while the sheet shrinks, and the stats scene unfolds from the folded faces back to full size, its rows settling in.

entries.name: Outline dissolve
entries.one_line: On a dark stage the invite card loses its fills until only thin yellow outlines remain, the outlines cross into the stats scene's outlines, and the stats scene fills back in with colour before its rows settle.

entries.name: Overlay bridge
entries.one_line: A big yellow disc carrying a ring mark sweeps across the stage and hides the cut: the invite scene is behind it until its centre passes the middle, the stats scene after; the rows settle and the disc sweeps back the other way.

entries.name: Paint splatter wipe
entries.one_line: Yellow paint droplets land around the invite card, then one irregular blob bursts from the centre and spreads until the stats scene shows through all of it, a yellow rim riding the edge; the rows then settle in.

entries.name: Perspective swap
entries.one_line: The invite card in front and the stats card behind it trade places: one slides right and sinks back, the other comes forward to the centre, with their floor reflections following.

entries.name: Phosphor trail dissolve
entries.one_line: On a dark stage the bright parts of the invite card, the headline, the yellow button and the avatar rings, glow up, the cut lands, and their yellow afterglow lingers over the stats scene and decays frame by frame as the rows settle in.

entries.name: Reaction cut
entries.one_line: The seats tag on the invite card turns yellow and pops; the view cuts straight to a shape-avatar face for Sam Kim whose brows lift, eyes widen and mouth opens while the shot eases in, then cuts back to the card.

entries.name: Retreat and cover
entries.one_line: An invite card shrinks and darkens as a stats card slides in from the right and covers it; then the stats card retreats the same way and a third card covers it, so the scenes stack like layers.

entries.name: Ring zoom
entries.one_line: Three concentric rings show the invite scene at growing magnifications toward the centre, like a tunnel, and the stats scene replaces it ring by ring from the centre outward; its rows then settle in.

entries.name: Ripple dissolve
entries.one_line: The invite scene is sliced into concentric rings that swell and settle in a wave travelling out from the centre, each ring thinning away so the stats scene shows through from the middle outward.

entries.name: Rotating tile dissolve
entries.one_line: The invite scene repeats as a grid of small tiles that turns ninety degrees around the stage centre and swells, while the stats scene fades in beneath and the tiles shrink away from the middle outward.

entries.name: Scribble wipe
entries.one_line: Ten thick ink scribble strokes draw quickly across the invite scene from top to bottom until it is covered, the scene swaps underneath, and the scribble wipes itself off to show the stats scene.

entries.name: Shatter transition
entries.one_line: The invite scene breaks into 24 polygon fragments that fly outward, spin, drop and fade to reveal the stats scene behind; then six fragments of the new scene fly in and gather into its disc.

entries.name: Shot reverse shot
entries.one_line: Two speaker panels face each other across the same axis, one from the left facing right and one from the right facing left, and the video cuts between them as each line lands in a speech bubble.

entries.name: Smash cut
entries.one_line: A quiet invite card with a slowly drifting cursor cuts without warning to a loud black panel with a huge yellow number that shakes and settles, then cuts back just as hard and the cursor clicks Continue.

entries.name: Solarized dissolve
entries.one_line: The invite scene passes into a high-contrast, mostly inverted print-like state, the stats scene takes over at the peak, and it comes back out of the same inverted state to normal colour; its rows then settle in.

entries.name: Speed ramp
entries.one_line: A cursor races across the stage, slows right down to a quarter speed for the click on Continue so the press and ripple read, then speeds back up on the way out; a readout and a speed curve with a playhead show the ramp.

entries.name: J-cut and L-cut
entries.one_line: A picture strip sits over a drawn waveform strip scrolling under a playhead: the sound switches to the next scene's pattern 0.4 s before the picture cuts to it, then the picture cuts back while the old sound lingers 0.4 s.

entries.name: Split panel handoff
entries.one_line: The title "Launch day." splits along its middle, the top half rising and the bottom half dropping, while a yellow panel grows from the opening and takes over the stage with the month's number; its rows then settle in.

entries.name: Squeeze transition
entries.one_line: The invite scene is squashed sideways into its right edge like a closing door, and the stats scene unfolds back out from that same edge.

entries.name: Static band wipe
entries.one_line: An 80 px band of grey static sweeps from the top of the stage to the bottom, and everything above its lower edge has already become the stats scene; its rows then settle in.

entries.name: Stereo viewer swap
entries.one_line: The invite scene shrinks into a rounded window, splits into two halves that swing apart into the dark, and after a short gap the stats scene opens as a window and grows back to full size.

entries.name: Swirl transition
entries.one_line: Eight concentric rings of the invite scene twist around the centre by amounts that grow toward the middle, like a whirlpool, the stats scene takes over at the peak and untwists from the same rings; its rows then settle in.

entries.name: Tangent blur spin
entries.one_line: An invite card swings out of frame around its bottom-left corner, blurring and smearing along the arc, while a stats card swings up into place around the opposite corner and rocks once as it lands.

entries.name: Text cutout zoom
entries.one_line: A stats scene shows through the O of a huge ORBIT title cut out of a dark plate; the letter-shaped hole grows about its centre until the whole frame is the scene, then the names settle in.

entries.name: Text half split
entries.one_line: The top and bottom halves of a headline tear apart upward and downward, and the next phrase's halves close in from the opposite sides a tenth of a second later; the swap runs again for a third phrase.

entries.name: Time compression
entries.one_line: An upload bar that would take minutes creeps at real speed, then races ahead under a ×8 badge and an ellipsis marker while the clock readout skips, and the result lands as Done.

entries.name: Tinted burn dissolve
entries.one_line: An invite card runs hot yellow-orange, as if lit from behind by a warm glow, while it blends into a stats card that comes in clean; then the burn runs back the other way.

entries.name: Title card rhythm
entries.one_line: Three name cards with a role line land one after another on a steady 0.6 s beat, each with a small pop and an instant cut to the next, and the key title card holds longest with a yellow underline drawing in.

entries.name: Translate fade
entries.one_line: In a list of three people, each row's old status slides off to the left while fading and blurring, and the new status slides into the same zone from the right and sharpens, one row after another; then the rows advance once more.

entries.name: TV static transition
entries.one_line: Grey TV static rises over an invite card for half a second, the picture changes to a stats card under the noise with a white kick, and the static clears; a shorter signal drop later flips it back.

entries.name: TV tracking transition
entries.one_line: A third of the horizontal scan lines of an invite card slip sideways as if the tape lost tracking, a dark bar rolls down the frame, and a stats card is there when the lines settle; a shorter slip later brings the first card back.

entries.name: Warp dissolve
entries.one_line: An invite card stretches, skews and slides to the right as it fades, while a stats card arrives stretched the opposite way and fades in; both relax to flat at the swap, and later the warp runs back.

entries.name: Wave dissolve
entries.one_line: An invite card and a stats card blend while the whole picture sways in three travelling sine waves, as if seen through water; the wave is flat at both ends and relaxes on the new card, then runs back once more.

entries.name: Wind wipe
entries.one_line: An invite card is blown off in 24 horizontal streaks, each line's edge racing to the right a little ahead of or behind its neighbours, revealing a stats card underneath; then the same wind blows the first card back in from the left.

entries.name: Zigzag wipe
entries.one_line: A sawtooth boundary of twelve 80 px teeth, edged in yellow, sweeps left to right across an invite card and reveals a stats card behind it; the same zigzag runs again and takes it away.

entries.name: Zoom flash
entries.one_line: An invite card zooms in hard and blurs bright, a white flash fills the frame at the peak, and a stats card settles in from large to its place as the flash fades; then the same punch cuts back.

entries.name: Camera cursor tracking
entries.one_line: A long line types into a search bar with a blinking yellow cursor; the view holds still at first, then slides left to keep the cursor in frame as the text outgrows the screen.

entries.name: Coordinate target zoom
entries.one_line: Three cards sit scattered across the frame; the camera zooms into the one at the top right so it lands dead centre, then a yellow ring confirms it while the view holds.

entries.name: Depth of field blur
entries.one_line: A grid of six stat cards: five of them soften and dim while the camera pushes in a little, leaving the one metric card crisp in the middle, then the whole grid comes back into focus.

entries.name: Multi-phase camera
entries.one_line: The whole scene starts pulled back a little, settles to normal size as the card's text and button fade in, then pushes in slowly, with a gentle wandering drift the entire time so the camera never feels locked.

entries.name: Viewport change
entries.one_line: One smooth camera move zooms and pans the whole card so the yellow Continue button in its corner ends up large and centred, holds there, then the button presses once.

entries.name: Giant mask reveal
entries.one_line: A stage-filling numeral 3 is a window onto a plate behind it; the camera dives into its thickest stroke, the glyph window growing exponentially until the whole plate is revealed and a yellow bar draws.

entries.name: Infinite canvas pan
entries.one_line: One continuous 5,400px camera pan across six product plates on a single long canvas, settling on a yellow focus on the last plate.

entries.name: Infinite zoom
entries.one_line: The camera dives into a yellow dot twice: three nested pages expand through a continuous 196x zoom, each page's dot turning out to hold the next page.

entries.name: Ken Burns
entries.one_line: A product card slowly zooms to 1.12x at a constant speed while drifting up and to the left, the classic still-image camera move.

entries.name: Pan
entries.one_line: A three-station strip scans left at constant scale and stops on station 3, which lights up in yellow.

entries.name: Parallax
entries.one_line: Three layers slide left under one camera move at different speeds: a faint far number barely moves, middle blocks move more, a near yellow dot moves fastest, so flat shapes read as depth.

entries.name: Perspective tilt reveal
entries.one_line: A page of nine figures tilts back by 55 degrees to reveal its whole grid, drifts, then returns frontal onto the one yellow figure.

entries.name: Push-in
entries.one_line: The sentence "Every frame is code." slowly pushes in to 1.6x around the word "frame", the other words sliding toward the edges, then a yellow underline draws under it.

entries.name: Scroll-scrub cinema scene
entries.one_line: One pinned scene driven by a single scroll progress value, played back by the timeline: the title rises through a mask, a three-node diagram assembles and draws its arrows, the background number parallaxes, and the next scene scrolls in while a rail shows the progress.

entries.name: Camera follow
entries.one_line: A yellow subject marker hops along a row of four step cards; once it would pass 65% of the framed viewport, the whole world slides left a beat later to park it at the 60% anchor line, twice in a row.

entries.name: Camera orbit
entries.one_line: An invite card stands on a floor grid as a solid object; the camera swings 60 degrees around it from slightly above, holds on the three-quarter view and swings back, while dots at different depths shift their positions against it.

entries.name: Crane tilt
entries.one_line: A tall members page is first seen from above, leaning away; the viewpoint descends and levels out until the member list sits square in front, then a yellow highlight lands on the invite row as the view eases closer.

entries.name: Dolly zoom
entries.one_line: An invite card holds exactly its size while the field of faint cards behind it swells and flattens as the camera pulls back and narrows its view, then the space relaxes again.

entries.name: Fly-to
entries.one_line: On a dotted map the view pulls back from one member's pin, glides across the wider map while a route line draws, and dives in on the second member's pin, which fills yellow and pulses on arrival.

entries.name: Frame scrub
entries.one_line: A baked 24-frame sequence of an invite card sliding open and a check drawing in is scrubbed forward by a progress bar, held, then scrubbed back in reverse, with the current frame number stepping along a tick row.

entries.name: Lens distortion zoom
entries.one_line: The view rushes toward an invite card on a dotted grid; as it closes in, the grid lines bow outward like a wide lens and straighten again at the end of the push, then the view eases back out the same way.

entries.name: Screen shake
entries.one_line: A SENT stamp slams onto a product card and the whole frame trembles side to side for a quarter second with a decaying amplitude, returning exactly to rest; a lighter second hit lands with a +3 chip.

entries.name: Vanishing point shift
entries.one_line: A flat members page sits between a floor grid, a tilted side panel and floating chips; nothing in the layout moves, only the vanishing point slides from left to right and then lower, so the depth around the page re-projects and the viewpoint seems to shift.

entries.name: Chart scrub readout
entries.one_line: A dashed tracking line and a yellow marker sweep left to right along a line chart that is already drawn, while a dark tooltip steps through the dates and values and lands on the final peak with a small pop.

entries.name: Stat bars and fills
entries.one_line: Five bars grow up from the baseline one after another with the last one in yellow, while a big percentage counts up and a progress bar fills beside it to the same beat.

entries.name: Annotation callout
entries.one_line: A chart line arrives, a yellow dot marks one point, a leader line draws out from it and the annotation text fades in beside it.

entries.name: Bar chart race
entries.one_line: Five horizontal bars lengthen through three yearly snapshots and swap vertical rank as their values cross, the leader turning yellow while the year counter and values update.

entries.name: Bar grow
entries.one_line: Five horizontal bars grow from the left on a shared scale, top to bottom a beat apart, the leading one in yellow, and their percentages fade in at the tips.

entries.name: Dot regroup
entries.one_line: Thirty scattered dots glide into two orderly groups, eighteen yellow on the left and twelve ink on the right, and the group counts fade in below.

entries.name: Pie and donut update
entries.one_line: A three-slice donut re-divides itself as the shares change, the yellow slice widening then easing back, while the centre percentage and legend values count along.

entries.name: Progress ring
entries.one_line: A yellow circular stroke fills clockwise from twelve o'clock to 75% while the percentage in its centre and the count beside it climb to the same value, then nudge up a little more.

entries.name: Radar chart morph
entries.one_line: A yellow radar outline grows out from a dashed before-profile as its five vertices slide along fixed axes to the after-values, then settle slightly.

entries.name: Sankey ribbon growth
entries.one_line: Two flow ribbons, one ink and one yellow, grow from the source column to the middle nodes and then on to the destination, revealing the split and the merge one stage at a time.

entries.name: Stacked-to-grouped transition
entries.one_line: Three stacked bars of ink and yellow segments first narrow and spread sideways into pairs, then the floating segments drop onto the shared baseline so the series can be compared.

entries.name: Table-to-chart transition
entries.one_line: A four-row table highlights its leading value, grows a small mark beside each number, then the marks stretch into bars of proportional length with the numbers riding out to the tips.

entries.name: Unit grid fill
entries.one_line: A grid of thirty cells fills eighteen of them with yellow in sequence from left to right, each fill rising from the cell's bottom edge, and the count reads out below.

entries.name: Waterfall accumulation
entries.one_line: Bars rise one after another, each starting from the top of the previous running total with a short connector between them, the one yellow bar stepping down, until a final total bar lands.

entries.name: Aggregate split and merge
entries.one_line: One wide bar of 12,480 invites comes apart into three named bars that slide onto their own rows, then fold back into the single total.

entries.name: Audio spectrum visualizer
entries.one_line: Thirty-two frequency bars bounce to a baked band table under a now-playing title, with a yellow cap riding whichever bar is loudest at that moment.

entries.name: Audio waveform
entries.one_line: A baked waveform scrolls right to left under a fixed yellow playhead, the played part in ink and the part still to come in grey, while the clock ticks from 0:12.

entries.name: Axis rescaling
entries.one_line: A value too big for a 0-100 line chart arrives, so the axis rescales to 0-200: the kept ticks and gridlines slide to their new rows, two new ticks fade in, and every mark and the line move with them.

entries.name: Beeswarm settling
entries.one_line: Forty dots stacked on a value axis lift off one after another into a non-overlapping swarm that keeps every dot's value position, the yellow top value settling last with its name.

entries.name: Boxplot update
entries.one_line: Three boxplots of days to accept an invite slide their boxes, yellow medians and whiskers to the next month's summary, an outlier fading out and a new one in, then update once more.

entries.name: Brush-linked update
entries.one_line: A yellow brush window slides along a 90-day overview line and then widens, and the detail chart below re-draws its path to the selected days each time it moves.

entries.name: Animated bubble time series
entries.one_line: Five team bubbles drift across an invites-versus-accepted chart and grow in area at the same time while a big year label steps from 2023 to 2026.

entries.name: Bump chart reveal
entries.one_line: Four rank lines unfold left to right across five months, crossing wherever two names swap places, and the yellow line that ends in first place gets its name and a ring as the reveal lands.

entries.name: Cartogram transition
entries.one_line: Twelve rounded map regions slide into a grid of squares sized by how many invites each sent, their names travelling with them, then settle back into the map.

entries.name: Connected change arrows
entries.one_line: For four names an arrow grows from last month's fixed dot to this month's value, one pointing left for a drop, with the biggest change in yellow and singled out at the end.

entries.name: Chart filter fade
entries.one_line: A scatter of 30 invites: choosing the Accepted filter fades every other dot to a trace in place, then the This week filter swaps which dots show, some faded ones returning.

entries.name: Chart path morph
entries.one_line: A yellow area chart of invites per week reshapes smoothly into this quarter's numbers on the same axis, its line and dots moving with it, then morphs again into the forecast.

entries.name: Choropleth transition
entries.one_line: A hex map of 19 regions colours in west to east from pale to a yellow-to-ink ramp of invites sent, the legend fading in with it, then re-colours to the next month's values.

entries.name: Color encoding transition
entries.one_line: A grid of 24 member dots stays exactly where it is while the dots take on three team colours, then recolour again on a yellow ramp by invites sent; the legend and title change with them.

entries.name: Confidence band reveal
entries.one_line: An invites forecast line and the translucent yellow band around it unfold together from left to right, the band widening toward December; then more data arrives and the band narrows around the same line.

entries.name: Countdown ticker
entries.one_line: A launch countdown in days, hours, minutes and seconds ticks down once a second, each new seconds pair sliding up into place while a yellow time bar drains.

entries.name: Density field animation
entries.one_line: On an hours-by-weekday grid, soft yellow density blobs of team activity drift, swell and fade over the week, the densest cores darkening, instead of showing individual events.

entries.name: Donut ring staging
entries.one_line: A three-slice seats donut splits into three concentric rings, the rings turn so each starts at the top, their shares change as used seats go from 3 to 6 of 12, and then they pack back into one donut.

entries.name: Facet-to-single transition
entries.one_line: Three small team panels dissolve as their lines and dots travel onto one shared axis to overlay the trends, then the chart splits back into the three panels.

entries.name: Fisheye lens
entries.one_line: A fisheye focus sweeps across twenty thin daily bars: bars and day ticks near the focus widen and spread while the rest squeeze together, all inside the same chart width, the focused bar yellow with its value.

entries.name: Force layout settling
entries.one_line: Twelve team members and the links between them start as a tight knot and relax under repulsion, link springs and damping into a settled network, the hub breathing once when it comes to rest.

entries.name: Formation transition
entries.one_line: Seven numbered markers on a pitch outline glide from one formation to the next, each dragging a translucent trail of its path that fades once it arrives; then the whole shape presses up the pitch with fresh trails.

entries.name: Fractional icon fill
entries.one_line: A row of five outlined stars fills with yellow from the left and stops exactly at 4.5, half way through the fifth star; a second row then fills to 3.8.

entries.name: Freeze and replay
entries.one_line: A seats-used line draws up to the day only three seats are left, freezes there with a yellow callout, then jumps back a few days and replays that last stretch at half speed before freezing again.

entries.name: Gantt progress
entries.one_line: A NOW cursor sweeps across a Monday-to-Friday grid while four task bars (record, edit, review, ship) fill yellow behind it inside their scheduled windows; the review bar stops short, showing work that fell behind the schedule.

entries.name: Histogram rebinning
entries.one_line: Forty invites-per-day observations stacked in eight narrow bins, two clear peaks, travel to their places in four wider bins where the peaks merge into one flat block, outlines and edge labels changing with them; then they return to the finer bins.

entries.name: Hypothetical outcome cycle
entries.one_line: On fixed axes, one possible invites-next-quarter line is hard-swapped for the next of six sampled outcomes every 0.4 s, while the dashed average of all six stays put behind them; a counter and a row of pips say which outcome is showing.

entries.name: Interval expansion
entries.one_line: Four invites-per-week points, one per member and a yellow one for the team, expand in both directions at once into min-to-max range bars with end caps and numbers; then the team range widens again as more weeks are counted.

entries.name: Line chart race
entries.one_line: Three members' invite lines extend week by week while their endpoint dots and name tags ride the current values; whoever leads has the yellow tag, and the lead changes hands midway.

entries.name: Linear to log transition
entries.one_line: Twelve workspace marks piled at the bottom of a linear invites axis glide up to their places on a base-10 log axis while the gridline ticks slide between the two scales and the axis title crosses over; a trend line then draws through the now evenly spread marks.

entries.name: Map event accumulation
entries.one_line: On an abstract dotted map, yellow city markers pop in one after another in time order, each with a fading ring, and stay put while a running invite total and city count climb beside them.

entries.name: Map extrusion
entries.one_line: A tilted grid of nineteen hexagonal districts rises into prisms, each to a height set by its density and the densest tops in yellow, the tallest rising first while the ground slowly turns.

entries.name: Geographic outline comparison
entries.one_line: A yellow region outline slides across an abstract map and shrinks to its true relative size as it settles over a fixed grey reference outline, leaving a dashed ghost where it started, then nudges once into place.

entries.name: Map route animation
entries.one_line: A yellow marker travels along a route across an abstract dotted map from Jamie to Sam to Morgan while the route line draws behind it, with a ring pulse at each pin it reaches.

entries.name: Map to bar chart
entries.one_line: A flat seven-region hex map tilts into a height map, each region rises as a prism to its value, then the prisms slide into a row sorted along a baseline so the map becomes a bar chart.

entries.name: Matrix row-column sorting
entries.one_line: A six by six grid of shaded cells glides into a new row and column order while every cell and name label keeps its identity, and two dense clusters that were hidden are outlined in yellow once the sort lands.

entries.name: Motion trails
entries.one_line: A yellow point glides along a curving path across a chart and leaves a tail of twenty shrinking, fading dots joined by a faint line, so its direction and recent positions stay readable next to where it is now.

entries.name: Object-constant update
entries.one_line: Six named, coloured member dots keep their colour and name while gliding from a ranked bar list into a scatter plot of invites against reply rate, and back again.

entries.name: Oscilloscope trace
entries.one_line: On a dark scope grid, a bright yellow sampling point sweeps left to right drawing a waveform whose trail fades exponentially behind it, then a second sweep retraces over the dimming first one.

entries.name: Percent normalization
entries.one_line: Three stacked bars of different lengths stretch to the same full width while each one's joined, pending and declined segments keep their proportions, as the invite-count axis gives way to a percent axis ending at 100%.

entries.name: Point-to-point construction
entries.one_line: A weekly line chart builds itself one observation at a time: a yellow point sets off from the last landed point and travels to the next week's value, extending the line segment by segment until the twelfth week is called out.

entries.name: Rank transition
entries.one_line: A four-row leaderboard re-sorts when the criterion changes: each row keeps its name, colour and bar and glides to its new rank, then sorts back.

entries.name: Ribbon-to-particle transition
entries.one_line: A yellow flow band between an invites column and an accepted column dissolves into forty travelling dots, one per ten invites, that stream along the same path, then the band re-forms as the dots fade.

entries.name: Rolling digits
entries.one_line: A big count rolls up to 12,480 one digit reel at a time inside a clipped window, the comma holding still, then rolls on again to a higher number.

entries.name: Sankey reflow
entries.one_line: A two-stage flow from sent to opened to joined updates its numbers: ribbon widths, node heights and the points where they meet all move together, first as more invites are opened and joined, then again as the figures settle lower.

entries.name: Scatter dimension rotation
entries.one_line: Scatter points spread out in depth along a third variable, the whole cloud and its axis frame turn 90 degrees, and the points settle into the plane of the new variable pair, the Sales points pulsing once.

entries.name: Animated size encoding
entries.one_line: Five yellow circles, one per team member, grow from their fixed centres to areas proportional to each person's invite count, then resize together to a second week's numbers while the counts tick alongside.

entries.name: Stack layer addition
entries.one_line: A stacked area chart of invites by team gains a new yellow layer at its base: the layer thickens from nothing while the three layers above ride up on it without a gap, then it grows once more.

entries.name: Staged chart transition
entries.one_line: A quarterly bar chart turns into a scatter plot in three separate stages: first the axis changes, then the dots move to their new positions, then the dots change size.

entries.name: Streamgraph baseline shift
entries.one_line: Four stacked activity layers drift from a centred streamgraph shape down onto a flat zero baseline, every boundary moving by the same per-week offset, hold there, then float back to the centred form.

entries.name: Streaming chart
entries.one_line: A live line chart of invites per minute scrolls left as new samples arrive at the right edge, each newest point ringed in yellow while older points and their time ticks slide out of view.

entries.name: Temporal network transition
entries.one_line: A team graph steps through three monthly snapshots: members and their links fade in or out and drift to new positions, newcomers shown in yellow, while the month label and counts update.

entries.name: Track data race
entries.one_line: Three named runner dots travel one lap of an oval track at speeds set by their recorded checkpoint times, the leader's dot and lane turning yellow as the lead changes and a clock counts to the finish.

entries.name: Tree expand and collapse
entries.one_line: An org tree unfolds from the root: three team nodes and their links grow out of it, then nine member initials grow out of the teams, and finally the members fold back into their teams.

entries.name: Tree re-rooting
entries.one_line: A selected team member rises to the top of the org tree while the old root and every connected branch slide into the new layout along the same links, then the tree re-roots back.

entries.name: Treemap resizing
entries.one_line: Six team rectangles in a treemap of invites resize to a new month's shares without swapping neighbours, their names and counts riding along and the largest tile turning yellow, then resize back.

entries.name: Uncertainty needle motion
entries.one_line: A forecast gauge needle hops every 0.4 s between sampled outcomes on either side of the 62 percent estimate, inside a pale band of plausible values with the central tick in yellow.

entries.name: Unit-to-aggregate transition
entries.one_line: Thirty-six scattered invite squares travel into four team bins and stack into the shape of a bar chart; the bar outlines appear around them, then the bars fill yellow and their counts land on top.

entries.name: AI tracking box
entries.one_line: Four yellow corner brackets snap onto a pale circle, then follow it around an oval path while the box breathes slightly and a confidence readout flickers between 95 and 99 percent.

entries.name: Anchored layout expand
entries.one_line: A dropdown springs open under its header, three member rows arriving as it grows, and the card with the yellow button below rides down in contact with its edge, then it snaps shut.

entries.name: Avatar cloud network
entries.one_line: A member count pops in at the centre, eight initials circles cascade onto a ring around it, dashed lines draw out from the hub to each one, and the ring breathes.

entries.name: Center outward expansion
entries.one_line: Six small cards start piled at the centre and radiate out to their places in one eased burst, then float gently where they landed.

entries.name: Answer streaming
entries.one_line: An assistant's answer appears in ten word groups, one every 0.18 s, each new group fading from pale to full ink while a yellow cursor block sits at the end of the text.

entries.name: Chat thread
entries.one_line: Four chat messages appear one after another in a conversation card, each new bubble popping in from its corner while the earlier messages shift upward to make room.

entries.name: Layout reflow
entries.one_line: One card in a grid of six fades out and the remaining cards glide into the freed slots, the last one stretching to fill two columns, so each card keeps its identity while the layout changes.

entries.name: Modal lift
entries.one_line: A pointer presses Save and a confirmation dialog rises 32 px into focus, settling from slightly smaller to full size, while the workspace behind it dims to 45% ink.

entries.name: Spotlight
entries.one_line: A list dims to a quarter of its ink while one row keeps full contrast, and yellow brackets draw around that row to mark the region to read now.

entries.name: Typing input
entries.one_line: A search field types "Invite my team" character by character at uneven human gaps, a yellow caret blinking at the insertion point and then holding steady once the line is complete.

entries.name: UI scroll
entries.one_line: A long help document glides 555 px upward inside its window with the rail thumb following, stops with the target section 30 px inside the frame, and a yellow vertical line stands up beside it.

entries.name: Zoom callout
entries.one_line: A ring marks a small value in a list, a hairline draws out to the side, and a large yellow-rimmed circular callout grows from it showing the same value 4.5 times bigger.

entries.name: Active indicator glide
entries.one_line: A yellow underline glides along a tab row to each tab the cursor clicks, stretching to the new tab's width while the panel below crossfades; three tab changes in a row.

entries.name: Adaptive header
entries.one_line: On a members page, scrolling the list down slides the header bar out of view; a scroll back up brings it back compact, and reaching the top restores it in full.

entries.name: Card stack shuffle
entries.one_line: Three member cards sit in an offset stack; the rear card lifts and tilts, travels over the others and settles at the front while they step back, then the next rear card does the same.

entries.name: Carousel slide
entries.one_line: A rail of five step cards is thrown left and decelerates into the next centred card with a small overshoot; the centred card grows slightly and the dot indicator glides along, then the rail throws once more.

entries.name: Character input response
entries.one_line: On a sign-in panel, a round face follows the caret with its eyes while an email types, then covers its eyes with two hands as the password dots appear, and uncovers them when the caret moves on to the button.

entries.name: Cursor follow
entries.one_line: A pointer moves along a bent path over an invite card; a yellow ring with a name tag trails it with a short lag, overshooting at each turn before catching up.

entries.name: Cursor trail
entries.one_line: A pointer sweeps across an invite card to the Continue button leaving a trail of short segments that fade behind it, clicks, then moves off again with a fresh trail.

entries.name: Diff reveal
entries.one_line: In a short config file, a removed line fades in on a red tint with a minus sign and gets struck through, then the replacement line slides in on a green tint with a plus sign; a second change follows and a change count pops in.

entries.name: Dock magnification
entries.one_line: A pointer sweeps along a dock of seven app icons; each icon grows as the pointer nears it and shrinks as it passes, then the pointer comes back and rests on Search, which stays enlarged.

entries.name: Drawer slide
entries.one_line: A settings drawer springs in from the right edge while the page behind shrinks slightly and dims; a switch flips inside it, then the drawer slides back out and the page returns.

entries.name: Elastic boundary return
entries.one_line: A pointer drags a member card past the list's dashed edge; beyond it the card moves at half the pointer's speed while a yellow band stretches between them, and on release the card springs back inside, then it happens once more.

entries.name: Error shake
entries.one_line: An email field with an incomplete address gets a yellow ring and a short horizontal shake with an error line; the ending is typed in, the ring clears and a check mark draws itself to confirm.

entries.name: File upload stack
entries.one_line: Three file cards lift into place one after another; each shows a bar filling yellow at its own pace and a check that pops in when its upload completes.

entries.name: Hold to confirm
entries.one_line: A cursor presses and holds a Continue button; a yellow fill grows across it for 1.2 s, then the label pops into a check mark reading Confirmed and the three invitees light up.

entries.name: Hotspot pulse
entries.one_line: A yellow dot sits on the Add chip of a form while rings expand and fade from it; the dot then glides to the Continue button and pulses there, marking the next click.

entries.name: Icon flight
entries.one_line: Inside an Export button the arrow icon lifts out of its window and fades as a check drops in from below and the text changes to Exported; a beat later the pair reverses.

entries.name: Idle cursor hide
entries.one_line: A pointer settles on a command field and stops; a small yellow ring counts down the idle time, the pointer shrinks and fades away, then reappears at full size the moment it moves again to a command row.

entries.name: Image fan out
entries.one_line: Five overlapping product frames spread sideways into a fan, each rotating a little more about a pivot below the stack, hold open, then fold back into the pile.

entries.name: Image generation scan
entries.one_line: A yellow scan band sweeps down an empty grid inside a card; coarse 16 px blocks appear just ahead of it and sharpen into a product screen as it passes, the percent counts up and a Ready pill pops at the end.

entries.name: Layout yield
entries.one_line: An invite card slides aside and shrinks to make room for a yellow message panel that arrives beside it; after a hold the panel leaves and the card moves back to the centre.

entries.name: Magnetic attraction
entries.one_line: As the cursor comes near, the yellow Continue button leans a few pixels toward it and follows as the cursor drifts; when the cursor leaves, the button springs back into place.

entries.name: Pull to refresh
entries.one_line: A member list is pulled down with resistance until a loader arc fills and spins at the threshold; the list springs back and a new member row appears at the top.

entries.name: Radial menu fanout
entries.one_line: Six icon discs fan out from a yellow plus button along a 120-degree arc with a short stagger while the plus turns into a close mark; after a hold they fold back into the button.

entries.name: Scroll grid expansion
entries.one_line: A grid of six product frames rises into place column by column, the whole grid expands, a caption line appears beneath it, and then the other frames fade back so one key frame stands out.

entries.name: Scroll lag
entries.one_line: The scrollbar jumps up in one step while the member list eases after it and the hero header trails even later, sliding under the list before it settles; then the page scrolls back the same way.

entries.name: Scroll snap
entries.one_line: A page of three chapters scrolls part of the way twice and each time settles smoothly onto the nearest chapter boundary, while a yellow marker on a dot rail moves to the chapter that snapped into view.

entries.name: Swipe action reveal
entries.one_line: A touch point drags a member row to the left, uncovering an Archive action and a yellow Remove action underneath; after a hold the row slides back over them with a small overshoot.

entries.name: Terminal run
entries.one_line: In a dark terminal window a command is typed character by character, pauses, then prints three result lines one after another and a summary; a new prompt appears and a second command is typed.

entries.name: Toast stack
entries.one_line: Beside a product card, notification toasts slide in from the right and stack upward; when the middle one is dismissed the toast above drops to close the gap, then a fourth arrives.

entries.name: Toggle slide
entries.one_line: In a settings card, a switch thumb travels across its track with a small overshoot and settles as the track turns yellow; a second switch follows and the first slides back off.

entries.name: Tracked redaction
entries.one_line: A blurred pill hides the email value in an account form; when a note expands above and the rows move down, the pill moves with the field, widens as the address gets longer, and rides back up when the note collapses.

entries.name: Vector pen demo
entries.one_line: A pen tool places three anchor points in turn, a smooth curve draws between them, the control handles extend from the anchors, and a dashed selection frame wraps the finished path.

entries.name: Attention lines
entries.one_line: The last word of a sentence lights up and arcs of different thickness and opacity draw back to the four earlier words, with the weights reading out below.

entries.name: Context window
entries.one_line: New letter tokens drop into a 16-slot window every 0.19 s; once it is full, everything shifts one slot left and the oldest token falls out bottom-left.

entries.name: Embedding space
entries.one_line: Six words in a row travel to coordinates on hairline axes so three names cluster left and three steps cluster right, then a yellow ring circles one cluster.

entries.name: Node-link build
entries.one_line: Five circle nodes pop in one by one, their connecting edges draw in order, then one path through the network thickens to ink and the end node turns yellow.

entries.name: Next-token pick
entries.one_line: Four candidate words grow probability bars under the sentence "Invite your ___", then the 62% winner, "team", lights up yellow and slides into the blank.

entries.name: Progressive disclosure
entries.one_line: Three stages, Draft, Review and Live, light up one after another with hairline arrows drawing between them, each earlier stage dimming as the next becomes active.

entries.name: Sequence message draw
entries.one_line: Between three lifelines (Jamie Dalton, Orbit, Sam Kim) the messages Invite, Deliver, Accept and Joined draw as arrows in time order, a yellow dot popping on each receiver.

entries.name: Source-to-result mapping
entries.one_line: A source card stays put while a result card slides in beside it, then connectors draw across between matching lines, underlining the source token and marking its result token yellow.

entries.name: Split compare
entries.one_line: A blurred before and a sharp after of the same number and line sit at identical coordinates while a vertical divider slides 50% → 35% → 65% → 50%, revealing each side through complementary clip-paths.

entries.name: State transition walk
entries.one_line: A yellow signal dot rides the edge from Draft to Review to Live; each node it reaches fills yellow as the current state while the one it left goes pale, with the caption below swapping to match.

entries.name: Token split
entries.one_line: The sentence "Every frame is code." spreads apart from its centre into five spaced pieces, the third one marked yellow, with hairlines and index numbers appearing under each in order.

entries.name: Vector tip-to-tail
entries.one_line: On a hairline grid a horizontal arrow and a diagonal arrow extend from one origin, the second slides so its tail sits on the first's tip, and a thick yellow resultant draws from the origin to the far tip.

entries.name: SVG icon enrichment
entries.one_line: Three icons wake up from the inside: the clock's hands turn at different speeds, the fan blades spin, the check badge pulses with a lagging ring, and a dashed line beneath them streams left to right.

entries.name: SVG path draw
entries.one_line: A yellow ring traces itself from the top, a check mark is drawn inside it, then a chart line draws across to a yellow end dot, and the text fades in once the last stroke has settled.

entries.name: Outline then fill
entries.one_line: A hexagon, a yellow circle and a triangle each draw their outline first as a travelling stroke, then their interior fills in with colour a moment later.

entries.name: Path highlight
entries.one_line: A short yellow stretch travels twice along a grey curve between three nodes at constant speed, showing the direction of flow while the line itself stays put.

entries.name: Piece assembly
entries.one_line: Six scattered, tilted squares, one of them yellow, travel and rotate one after another until they lock into a single gap-free mark.

entries.name: Shape split and merge
entries.one_line: A disc cut into three equal sectors, one of them yellow, slides apart along the cuts, holds as three separate pieces, then slides back together into one whole.

entries.name: Ambient glow bloom
entries.one_line: On a dark ground a soft yellow halo swells in behind a card as the card settles, keeps breathing faintly, and a single raked band of light slides once across the card's face.

entries.name: Chromatic glitch
entries.one_line: A headline stretches in while yellow and grey ghost copies stutter behind it, snaps sharp, then twitches twice more in short bursts and holds clean (the colour-split form).

entries.name: Marker highlight
entries.one_line: Highlight sweep: a translucent yellow marker bar sweeps left to right behind one word, then another, then a phrase on the line below.

entries.name: Typewriter
entries.one_line: Typewriter: a yellow cursor blinks, then types out a headline one character at a time at a natural pace and goes back to blinking when it is done.

entries.name: Film grain
entries.one_line: A headline and a yellow disc on paper; a fine grain layer, swapped between eight seeded tiles at 12 fps, slides over the right half so the clean and textured versions sit side by side.

entries.name: Fluted glass drift
entries.one_line: A panel of 18 vertical glass flutes glides across a headline, a yellow disc and a row of bars, stretching and folding whatever sits behind it as it passes.

entries.name: Ink bleed
entries.one_line: Dark ink blobs bleed into the paper and merge into one soft stain, then contract and sharpen into a crisp headline, with a yellow mark landing beside it.

entries.name: Light sweep
entries.one_line: A tilted band of yellow-white light passes once through a giant 98% and a three-line title, only inside the glyphs like a metallic sheen, and a yellow underline lands once it has gone.

entries.name: Text echo trail
entries.one_line: A headline slides in fast with six delayed, fading copies trailing behind it and merging into one as it settles; a sub-line then crosses from the right with the same trail.

entries.name: Particle burst
entries.one_line: Confetti pop: a big number springs in and, as it lands, a handful of yellow and ink chips erupt from behind it, arc down under gravity and vanish in a blink.

entries.name: Flow field
entries.one_line: Six hundred pale points with short trails drift across a dark stage along the curves of an invisible, slowly turning flow field.

entries.name: Halftone motion
entries.one_line: A grid of ink dots on paper keeps its centres fixed while a diagonal wave rolls through the dot sizes, like a printed halftone coming alive.

entries.name: Particle scatter & assemble
entries.one_line: Nine hundred drifting particles fly in on gently bent paths, the farthest arriving last, and assemble into the big number 1,284 while the camera eases back; the last digit turns yellow once it has formed.

entries.name: Particle image reveal
entries.one_line: Particles scattered across a dark stage drift together, each carrying its target colour, until they form three pale bars and a yellow disc, then the solid picture fades in over them.

entries.name: Connected particle network
entries.one_line: Eighty-four pale dots sway slowly on a dark stage and join to any neighbour within reach by a line that fades with distance; one yellow node draws its links in yellow.

entries.name: 3D camera flight
entries.one_line: From a wide view of a gridded floor the camera dives down onto one card at an angle, holds, then flies sideways across the floor to a second card while focus racks from the first card to the second and a big floating number drifts past out of focus.

entries.name: 3D page scroll
entries.one_line: A tall page sits in a tilted card; it scrolls down in two spring-eased steps to a section with a yellow button, and a spotlight dims everything but that section.

entries.name: 3D text depth layers
entries.one_line: A huge yellow word gains a stacked dark extrusion behind it as six offset copies fade in back to front, then the depth breathes gently on a slow heartbeat.

entries.name: Depth scatter assemble
entries.one_line: Ten letter tiles tumble in from a rotating cloud of depth, each from its own point in space, and lock into the flat words EVERY FRAME.

entries.name: Hacker flip 3D
entries.one_line: Each letter of the line flips up from flat in 3D while cycling through scrambled glyphs, then clicks into the real character left to right, with a yellow underline filling underneath as it decodes.

entries.name: Orbit 3D entry
entries.one_line: Six shape badges flip up out of depth onto a tilted ring, a yellow label pops in at the centre, and the ring keeps circling it, passing in front and behind.

entries.name: Split tilt cards
entries.one_line: Two cards slide in from opposite sides and pivot to face each other like an open book, their copy rising as they settle, then bob gently out of step.

entries.name: Camera fly-through
entries.one_line: The camera flies forward through seven planes spaced 900px apart in depth, each fading in from far away and passing the lens, and stops on the final yellow line.

entries.name: Card flip
entries.one_line: A card rotates 180 degrees around its vertical axis to swap its front (Invite your team) for its back (12,480 invites sent), then turns on back to the front.

entries.name: 3D card flip stack
entries.one_line: Five overlapping sheets flip up in sequence 0.18 s apart and stack tilted behind, leaving the fifth, yellow-numbered sheet frontal and in focus.

entries.name: Coverflow
entries.one_line: Five step cards travel along a curved arrangement: the centre card faces front and large while side cards tilt 45 degrees away and shrink, the focus stepping through three cards.

entries.name: Deep multi-layer parallax
entries.one_line: One horizontal camera move across seven layers at seven speeds, from a blurred faint far number to a big soft near word, so the flat scene reads as deep space.

entries.name: Layer separation
entries.one_line: Three stacked card layers, seen at an angle, lift apart to their own depths, then fold back together and the stack rotates flat into one card.

entries.name: Sine wave loop
entries.one_line: A card pops into place and then breathes very slightly, drifting a few pixels up and down and swelling a hair, while the yellow badge on its corner pulses a quarter beat out of step.

entries.name: Arc spinner
entries.one_line: A yellow arc spins three times around a ring with a 3 in the middle, lengthening and shortening as it goes, so it reads as work in progress with no end estimate.

entries.name: Loading dots
entries.one_line: Three dots under a headline hop up 8 px one after another in a 1.2 s cycle, the last one yellow, signalling a reply still being prepared.

entries.name: Marquee
entries.one_line: A belt of big words, Record · Edit · Ship with a yellow dot, duplicated three times, slides left at a constant speed between two rules like an endless ticker.

entries.name: Orbit loop
entries.one_line: Six dots, one of them yellow, circle a central disc labelled Orbit on the same radius at a constant angular speed, 60 degrees apart.

entries.name: Ripple rings
entries.one_line: Three thin rings grow out from a yellow dot in turn, 0.4 s apart, fading as they expand, so the dot reads as a signal spreading outward.

entries.name: Caption takeover
entries.one_line: A normal caption sits at the bottom of a product scene; for one beat it vanishes and the sentence fills the whole frame huge, then the big title fades and the caption is back in its rail.

entries.name: Karaoke caption
entries.one_line: The caption line never moves; a yellow pill lights up behind each spoken word in turn, word by word from left to right, so the reading position tracks the speech.

entries.name: Lower third reveal
entries.one_line: A name strap wipes in from the left at the bottom of the frame, the name and role slide onto it one after the other, it holds, then the whole strap slides out and fades.

entries.name: Word pop caption
entries.one_line: Caption words pop in one at a time in groups of three, each overshooting slightly before settling; when a group is done the next replaces it at once, the last word on a yellow pill.
